3532-5078-7328-8346.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7328-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

803-2981-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-2981-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

3055-4247-6553.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

777-1170-2921-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-2921-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

511-817-3921-4050-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.

Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3015-5256-5659-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Rhonas's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Rhonas.
As God-Eternal Rhonas is a Lhurgoyf due to Leyline of Transformation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Rhonas from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When God-Eternal Rhonas enters, it triggers, doubling the power of other creatures you control until end of turn.
Repeat.

457-1409-4574-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Reclaimer leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Reclaimer
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Reclaimer when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Reclaimer and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-4574-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

uses.n: Kirol, History Buff // Pack a Punch

1872-7547-7548.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Cast a copy of Pack a Punch from exile by paying {1}{R}{W}, unpreparing Kirol.
When you cast that spell, Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Composite Golem leaves the battlefield, Kirol triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the copy of Pack a Punch, milling a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on the target, and giving it trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

3439-4089-4613-7196.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Grub, Storied Matriarch.
Put Grub, Storied Matriach into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic enters, it triggers, returning Grub, Storied Matriarch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Agatha's Soul Cauldron by tapping it and exiling Civilized Scholar from your graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter on Glasspool Mimic.
Activate Glasspool Mimic using Civilized Scholar's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and discard Grub, Storied Matriarch. Glasspool Mimic will then untap itself and transform, but it will transform again into Grub, Storied Matriarch.
Glasspool Mimic triggers, returning Grub, Storied Matriarch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.
3439-4089-4613-7196.notes: This combo functions as Glasspool Mimic will only copy the characteristics from Grub, Storied Matriarch and not Grub, Notorious Auntie. This is outlined here: "712.8d While a double-faced permanent has its front face up, it has only the characteristics of its front face."

3197-4716-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2921-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

Najeela and Burakos triggers.

Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

Cast Walking Ballista from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Liberated Livestock, adding {C}{C}.
When Liberated Livestock dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Liberated Livestock trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat, a 1/1 Bird, and a 2/4 Ox creature token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Liberated Livestock to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two of the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Liberated Livestock by paying {5}{W}.
Repeat.
